messages:
Marco: Heads up — PR #8421 needs 2x LGTM before tonight's RC cutover (cutoff 18:30 UTC). Diff: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/pr/8421. Summary: fixes kv-cache overflow on very long prompts (allocator edge-case). Risk: small but touches runtime allocator; added extra nil-check and a graceful fallback to model-v1. Please take a look ASAP and leave LGTM if you can.

Jess: on it, should be able to review in ~25m.

Kevin: grabbing it now, will focus on the allocator changes.

Sam: I can act as second reviewer if both of you finish before cutoff.

Jess: left a small comment on src/runtime/kv_cache.c:312 about a potential double-free — pushed a suggestion. Also added a unit test that reproduces long-seq behavior.

Kevin: addressed Jess's suggestion in 8421.2 and re-ran tests locally. unit tests pass, added one more assert. Ran a quick smoke on staging, kv-cache holds stable for 2k token sequence.

release-bot: Reminder: RC cutover window opens 18:00 UTC. If approvals < 2 by 18:30 UTC, deployment will default to fallback policy (canary-only + pin to model-v0.9).

Marco: thanks — if we don't hit 2x LGTM by 18:20 I'll move to canary-only rollout and coordinate rollback plan. @Sam can you be on standby for the cutover at 18:00–19:00?

Sam: yep, I'll be available and on call.

Jess: LGTM :+1:

Kevin: LGTM :rocket:

Marco: merging now, initiating canary rollout. I'll post rollout link once started.

Marco: Rollout: https://releases.redwood.ai/rollouts/8421 — canary started (5% traffic). Monitoring metrics: qps and 99p latency within baseline so far.

Sam: monitoring looks green, no errors in allocator logs.

Marco: great, promoting to 25% in 10m if metrics stay healthy. Thanks everyone — closing thread. :tada:
